purpose: Fresh non-crypto discovery lane. No inheritance from crypto or failed futures candidates.
replication_rule: Do not inspect the locked replication window for a family unless that family first survives the full discovery gate. This replication is historical and same-source, not genuine future OOS.

session.missing_minutes: No interpolation. Any signal/entry/exit requiring a missing exact minute is ineligible.

ETF_ORB15_CONT_V1.signal: first close from 13:45 through 14:44 strictly above opening-range high => long; strictly below opening-range low => short

ETF_BB20_REVERT_V1.center: simple mean of the 20 closes ending at the signal bar
ETF_BB20_REVERT_V1.dispersion: population standard deviation of those same 20 closes
ETF_BB20_REVERT_V1.overlap: no overlapping positions; after a signal no new signal until its timed exit

controls.primary: fully reversed direction at identical signal, entry and exit timestamps

economics.friction_interpretation: stress allowance for spread, fees and slippage because minute bars do not contain executable BBO
